name: Mandarin Oriental, Hong Kong
insider_take: The original flagship that launched an empire - where legendary hospitality meets Victoria Harbour's glittering embrace.
whats_special: This is the founding hotel of the entire Mandarin Oriental chain, opening in 1963 as Hong Kong's first luxury hotel. The property sits directly on Victoria Harbour and houses two Michelin-starred restaurants - Pierre and Man Wah. The hotel's Rolls-Royce fleet has been chauffeuring guests for over four decades, making it one of the world's largest hotel-owned Rolls-Royce collections.
pro_tip: Book a harbour-view room on floors 15+ for unobstructed views of the Symphony of Lights show at 8pm nightly - the world's largest permanent light show recognized by Guinness World Records.
dont_miss: The Captain's Bar, a legendary watering hole that's been serving Hong Kong's elite since the 1960s, and afternoon tea at Clipper Lounge with panoramic harbour views. Take the complimentary Rolls-Royce to the Star Ferry Pier - just a 2-minute ride to catch the historic ferry that's been crossing the harbour since 1888.
pros: Iconic luxury hotel with legendary service standards
Prime Central District location with harbor views
World-class spa and multiple award-winning restaurants
Seamless blend of Oriental heritage and modern sophistication
cons: Busy Central District location can be crowded
